subject: Leadership Snapshot — Week of 2026-03-04: OKR health, wins / risks / asks
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Distro <leadership-distro@redwood.com>; Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>; Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Tomas Rivera <tomas@infra-partners.com>, Kelsey Morales <kelsey@skyline.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Leadership Snapshot — Week of 2026-03-04: OKR health, wins / risks / asks

Team —

Quick weekly snapshot ahead of the QBR prep call. I pulled the highlights that matter for exec review and flagged where I need decisions by EOD Friday. Please skim; I pulled the QBR deck (v2) and the OKR dashboard for reference (attached).

WINS
- Redwood Optimize alpha shipped to three pilots (Skyline, BeaconHealth, and AeroCloud). Initial latency/cost signal: -18% token cost on batching workloads for two pilots.
- New model routing policy rolled to 20% of traffic for Hosted API — no customer-visible regressions.
- Hiring: Senior Infra SWE offer accepted (starts 3/23).

OKR HEALTH (top-line)
- Serving performance KR: 62% complete (on track for target of 80% by end of Q2).
- Dedicated revenue KR: 44% of quarter target (pipeline looks healthy; one large commit may close next week).
- Reliability KR: SLO compliance slipped to 98.6% for long-tail requests (below 99.5% target).

RISKS / BLOCKERS
- Latency regression observed in runtime v0.12 for sequence lengths >12k during stress tests (root cause: new KV eviction heuristic interacting badly with continuous batching). Mitigation: rolling rollback to v0.11 for Dedicated fleets tonight; deeper fix targeted W2.
- Procurement: Skyline legal has a final redline on data retention clause — we need approval for a 13-month retention exception for the pilot. (Kelsey is looped.)
- QBR narrative: need a clear customer success story to pair with Optimize results — Monica, can you confirm which pilot will present?

ASKS (clear decisions requested)
1) Exec approval: Allow a temporary exception to retention policy for Skyline pilot (13 months) so they can run longer analyses. Decision needed by 2026-03-06 COB.
2) Signoff on QBR deck v2 (attached). If no comments, I'll publish the speaker notes and finalize slides by Friday morning.
3) Approve two-week focused sprint on runtime fixes (engineering headcount/prioritization). This will pull ~40% of infra team from new feature work; need buy-in for scope trade-offs.

Attached: QBR-deck-v2.pptx (1.8MB), OKR-progress-dashboard.csv

Thanks — quick responses appreciated. I will summarize replies in the QBR prep doc.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
VP Product Operations, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
(attachment: QBR-deck-v2.pptx)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership Snapshot — Week of 2026-03-04: OKR health, wins / risks / asks

Laura —

Thanks for the clear summary. For the QBR customer story, Skyline is the best candidate; Kelsey indicated they're happy to be featured and can provide a short quote and a technical contact for the deck. I can confirm by EOD today and pull together the three-slide customer highlight.

On retention: Skyline's pilot success metrics require at least 12 months of history for their compliance audit; 13 months is what they asked for. If legal/ops will accept an exception scoped to that pilot only, I support it.

I'll also prepare the customer impact slide and a one-paragraph script for the executive presentation.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Distro <leadership-distro@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership Snapshot — Week of 2026-03-04: OKR health, wins / risks / asks

Quick note — I agree with the rollback tonight for v0.12 on Dedicated. Two items to call out:
1) Finance wants visibility into the two-week focused sprint ask; this looks like a scope shift that may affect ramp for Dedicated commitments. Can we add a short cost/benefit line in the QBR appendix? I can ask Sasha in FP&A to draft an estimate.
2) On the Dedicated revenue pipeline: the large commit mentioned earlier (Deal 4821) has a procurement milestone on 3/11; if we need to defer capacity work it could push that milestone. Recommend we add a risk flag in the sales slide and a contingency plan.

On retention exception: Legal needs the exact retention language proposed. Laura, Monica — can you draft a single-paragraph exception we can share with Legal & Compliance?

— Mike
Michael Grant
Head of Revenue Operations
michael_grant@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Distro <leadership-distro@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Tomas Rivera <tomas@infra-partners.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership Snapshot — Week of 2026-03-04: OKR health, wins / risks / asks

Thanks all — quick updates and next steps: 

- Monica: please confirm Skyline's quote and send the one-paragraph script by EOD. I'll slot the customer slide into the deck.
- Mike: I'll add a 1-slide appendix with the sprint cost/benefit and include the FP&A estimate from Sasha when available.
- Retention exception: Monica + I will draft a single-paragraph exception and circulate to Legal by 2026-03-05 12:00 PT.
- Ops: rolling rollback scheduled for 23:00 PT tonight; Tomas, please confirm rollback plan and postmortem owner.

If there are no further edits, I'll mark the deck final at 09:00 on 2026-03-05 and lock slides for distribution to execs.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
VP Product Operations, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
